title: Quiet the Worker
story: A noisy worker is consuming a queue reserved for maintenance. Metrics is healthy and must keep reporting while the worker is paused.
objective: Stop the existing worker container, keep metrics running, and leave exactly two mission containers.
hints: docker ps shows the currently running mission containers.
docker stop changes an existing container from running to stopped.
explanation: Stopping a container ends its current process without deleting the container. Targeting the specific alias protects unrelated healthy services.
